knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says to identify the agreed criterion before judging any surface, and to confirm the correct location, work-order version, completion status and access restrictions before inspecting. Option 0 (how well the cleaner is liked) is not a check, and option 2 treats a photograph as proof, which the lesson does not say.
The lesson says to photograph only where permitted, to avoid faces, personal documents and identifying belongings, and to use minimum necessary evidence.
The lesson says to reinspect the same criterion rather than assuming the problem is resolved, and to record completion.

practicalCriteria: Learner describes a supplied defect in observable terms, including location, size and visibility from the standard viewing position.
Learner classifies each supplied defect as cosmetic, functional or safety-related using the business definitions, and classifies at the higher level where unsure.
Learner refers a supplied building, fixed electrical or gas defect without attempting a repair.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Inspection record with description, class and response for each defect
stopWorkCriteria: Learner attempts to repair a building, fixed electrical or gas defect
Learner continues work affected by a safety-related defect
